model.eligibility_note: Open weights; licence apache-2.0 as published on huggingface.co/unsloth/gpt-oss-120b-GGUF and described on the base model card openai/gpt-oss-120b as a permissive Apache 2.0 licence, both read 2026-11-17 by the orchestrator. Apache-2.0 is OSI-approved, so this slot qualifies as open-source as well as open-weight. Quantisation F16. Served self-hosted via llama.cpp on VT ARC Falcon node fal039:53013 over an SSH tunnel on localhost:8083; no third-party inference provider.

tool_access: chat-completions API only: no browsing, no shell, no filesystem. The orchestrator wrote every file and ran every check.
